Senior Software Engineer – C# .net Location: Hyderabad / Noida What Makes Us, Us Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp! At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values – caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. If you like what we’re saying, keep reading! WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US Join the Standard Configuration Framework area to develop XMGR, SimCorp’s configuration-management platform for SimCorp Dimension. You will help make configuration changes reliable, repeatable and traceable across development, test and production environments, supporting both cloud-hosted and on-premises deployments. This is a hands-on, C#/.NET-focused senior engineering role with opportunities to contribute across the stack. XMGR combines ASP.NET Core APIs, an Angular/TypeScript UI, Entity Framework Core and relational databases, with asynchronous messaging and workflow processing. You will evolve an established platform and turn complex configuration requirements into maintainable software. What You Will Be Responsible For Build and evolve C#/.NET services and ASP.NET Core APIs Design reliable asynchronous workflows with clear failure handling, safe retries and useful diagnostics, protecting configuration integrity when operations fail or are interrupted. Improve security, authorization, auditability, performance and observability; diagnose issues across application and integration boundaries. Improve automated unit and integration testing, code review and CI/CD; refactor existing code incrementally while preserving compatibility and behaviour Provide technical leadership through design discussions, mentoring and knowledge sharing; collaborate across engineering, configuration and platform teams to deliver the team’s definition of done. What We Value Degree in computer science, software engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Demonstrated hands-on experience ranging from 3 to 5 years developing production software in C#/.NET, with evidence of owning complex features and making sound technical decisions Experience building ASP.NET Core services and REST APIs, including API contracts, asynchronous programming, dependency injection and robust error handling. Practical application of object-oriented design, SOLID principles and appropriate design patterns; ability to navigate, debug and safely improve an established codebase. Experience with relational databases and SQL, using Entity Framework Core or a comparable ORM; understand data modelling, validation, serialization and schema compatibility. Understanding of reliable distributed or long-running operations: concurrency, retries, idempotency and partial failures, with the ability to diagnose problems using logs and telemetry. Strong automated unit and integration testing skills; experience with peer reviews, Git and CI/CD, and a commitment to maintainability, security and release quality. Ability to clarify requirements with domain stakeholders and collaborate in an Agile team; willingness to work across backend APIs and web UI when a feature requires it. DESIRABLE Experience with configuration-management or deployment-automation systems: versioned artifacts, dependency resolution, environment promotion, baseline comparison or audit trails. Angular and TypeScript experience, particularly reactive programming with RxJS and state management such as NgRx. Asynchronous messaging (for example NATS), OData APIs, Oracle or SQL Server, and application telemetry such as OpenTelemetry. Azure, enterprise authentication/authorization, Docker or Kubernetes, and automated build and deployment pipelines. Experience modernizing .NET applications while preserving integration compatibility; familiarity with NUnit, NSubstitute or equivalent testing tools. Experience in enterprise or financial software; familiarity with SimCorp Dimension is welcome but not required. Prior experience with XMGR or the Standard Configuration Framework is not required; you should be willing to learn the product and configuration domain. PERSONAL COMPETENCIES Take responsibility for, apply sound judgement and balance delivery with long-term quality Work constructively across cultures and disciplines; share knowledge, mentor colleagues and contribute to an inclusive team environment. Communicate clearly in spoken and written English, including technical decisions and documentation. Benefits Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days. Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take. NEXT STEPS Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process. For any questions you are welcome to contact Viswanath Tangella (viswanath.tangella@simcorp.com), Talent Acquisition Partner. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated. WHO WE ARE? For over 50 years, we have worked closely with large and global investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 2,500+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds in general. SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated in our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients. While striving to deliver client value, we believe it is vital to consider our people and our planet in every business decision we make. Acting responsibly is not optional. It is essential. Full Stack Engineer Intern Pathway, AI Platform | Kasparro | Bengaluru Kasparro measures and improves how brands appear in AI search engines. Our product is in production with paying clients in India and the US. You will build backend features, AI workflows, and dashboards in a mentored role, with code review before release. ROLE DETAILS  Experience: 0-1 years  Type: Internship pathway (three-month learning phase; Pre-Placement Offer based on performance)  Location: Bengaluru, on-site, five days a week (no remote option)  Reports to: Senior Engineer COMPENSATION • Training period (first 3 months): stipend of ₹30,000–35,000 per month, based on skills and interview performance. • On confirmation (PPO, based on performance): ₹5–8 LPA cash, plus an ESOP grant of matching value. Total ₹10–16 LPA. O UR STACK  Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, PostgreSQL, async pg, SQLAlchemy, Alembic, React, Next.js, Gemini and OpenAI APIs, Google ADK, LangGraph, Langfuse, Docker, Fly.io, GitHub Actions, Claude Code and Cursor. RESPONSIBILITIES • Build async FastAPI endpoints with validated requests, responses, and clear error handling. • Work on PostgreSQL tables, SQL queries, and database migrations. • Build agent tools and workflows; validate model outputs and debug failures using logs and traces. • Build React and Next.js dashboards and report views with AI coding tools. • Debug your features, add checks and tests, and ship through reviewed pull requests. REQUIREMENTS • Strong Python fundamentals, basic async, and FastAPI or an equivalent framework. • PostgreSQL: simple table design and SQL with joins, filters, and aggregations. • React: components, state, forms, and API calls with loading and error states. • Git and deployment: branches, pull requests, merge conflicts, and at least one deployed app. • At least one hands-on project using OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini APIs. • Strong problem-solving: read errors, investigate, and explain when you are blocked. • Claude Code or Cursor experience, or readiness to start within a week. PREFERRED Students from IITs, NITs, VIT, and IIITs are preferred. Production software experience, agent tools and multi-step workflows, exposure to Google ADK, LangGraph, or Langfuse, cloud or Docker experience, an accessible portfolio, or a testing habit. NOT REQUIRED  Professional AI experience, deep system design, AI search or SEO knowledge, or a particular degree. Shipped work matters. YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS  This is your learning phase. The PPO depends on shipped work, response to review feedback, and how you investigate failures.  Weeks 1-4: Learn the codebase and domain; ship small, reviewed changes  Weeks 5-8: Deliver small features from API to UI with engineering review  Weeks 9-12: Own a bounded feature, its tests, and its failure handling HIRING PROCESS  Round 1: Recruiter conversation and a focused 2-3 hour take-home assessment  Round 2: Engineering walkthrough of your assessment and project  Round 3: Founder conversation HOW TO APPLY  Email nehakannan@kasparro.com (CC: grandmaster@kasparro.com) with: 1. Your resume. 2. A repo, live app, or demo link. 3. One paragraph on the hardest bug you personally tracked down and how you found it. Applications without a project link will not be prioritized. Join a team of repeat founders that ships weekly, and build production AI systems used by paying clients while learning through direct engineering review. Description - Job Summary This role is responsible for developing software solutions that address specific user needs or business challenges. The role designs, codes, and implements software applications using appropriate programming languages, frameworks, and tools. The role works closely with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, provide technical insights, and ensure the successful execution of projects. Responsibilities Designs, develops, and implements software applications according to specifications, using appropriate programming languages and technologies. Analyzes design and determines coding, programming, and integration activities required based on specific objectives and established project guidelines. Designs limited enhancements, updates, and programming changes for portions and subsystems of end-user applications software running on local, networked, and Internet- based platforms. Executes and writes portions of testing plans, protocols, and documentation for assigned portion of application; identifies and debugs issues with code and suggests changes or improvements. Identifies opportunities for performance improvements and optimizes code and application performance. Provides ongoing maintenance, updates, and bug fixes to ensure software applications remain functional and up-to-date. Collaborates on software development projects with the engineering, sales, and customer services departments. Supports internal and external software products; generates ideas for software innovation based on market trends. Participates as a member of project team of other software applications engineers and internal and outsourced development partners to develop reliable, cost effective and high quality solutions for assigned applications portion or subsystem. Collaborates and communicates with internal and outsourced development partners regarding software applications design status, project progress, and issue resolution. Education & Experience Recommended Four-year or Graduate Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence. Typically has 2-4 years of work experience, preferably in applications engineering, programming, or a related field or an advanced degree with little or no work experience.
